name: Health check
description: Verify that the deployed backend is healthy and responding.

name: Get all doctors
description: Verify that the API returns real doctors from the database.

name: Get doctors by department
description: Verify that doctors can be filtered by a real department.

name: Unknown department
description: Verify that an unknown department returns no doctors instead of fabricated results.

name: Valid doctor availability
description: Verify that the API returns real available slots for a real doctor on a future working day.

name: Invalid doctor availability
description: Verify that an unknown doctor ID is rejected.

name: Successful booking
description: Book a real available slot using a unique evaluation patient and verify the appointment in the database.

name: Duplicate active slot
description: Attempt to book the same active doctor/date/time using another patient and verify that the conflict is rejected.

name: Invalid doctor booking
description: Attempt to book using a nonexistent doctor ID and verify that the backend rejects the request.

name: Invalid appointment time
description: Attempt to book outside the selected doctor's working hours and verify that the backend rejects the request.

name: Get patient appointments
description: Verify that an active evaluation appointment can be retrieved using the patient's phone number.

name: Successful reschedule
description: Move the evaluation appointment to another real available slot and verify both old and new appointment states.

name: Reschedule nonexistent appointment
description: Verify that rescheduling a nonexistent appointment fails safely.

name: Cancel active appointment
description: Cancel the active evaluation appointment and verify that its database status becomes cancelled.

name: Cancel nonexistent appointment
description: Verify that cancellation fails safely when no active appointment exists.
